description: FEDA double-wishbone vehicle on 4 inflatable ANCF FEM tires. Combines example 7 (FEDA suspension, Pitman steering, TSDA air springs) with example 2 (MuJoCo<->ANCF bead coupling). No rigid wheels: feda_rims_only.xml leaves only an R=0.286 rim bottom-out stop, so the FEM tires carry the full 1492 kg/corner. Locked solver budget substeps=10 / nr=2 / pcg=25 and material E=50MPa, kn=20k, alpha-damp=0.15 (settles at h=0.42 m, ~14-17 kN/corner; verified 2026-09-09). 30 kPa inflation.
